title: [RFQA] Verify add/remove cart functionality
user_story: As a shopper, I want to add a product to my cart and remove it so I can manage items before checkout.

acceptance_criteria.text: A shopper can add an available product to the cart.
The cart displays the selected product name and price.
The cart badge reflects one item after adding one product.
Removing the selected product empties the cart and clears the badge.
Results must be based on observed browser evidence, not unsupported LLM claims.
